name: 19066 · Merion Sta, PA
findings: ZIP 19066 (Merion Sta) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19066 (Merion Sta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
